title: A motorcycle-sidecar taxi, Saigon
description: A green motorcycle-sidecar taxi in profile — the driver in a pith helmet and sunglasses high on the saddle, two passengers under the yellow-and-green canopy of the sidecar box ahead of him, a smiling man visible. Mismatched wheels and patched fenders; behind, a white fence and villa gate, palms, a woman in a white blouse with a basket, a boy passing. "Random picture in Saigon."
researchNotes: Larry's caption of 2026-09-05 (giscus-vn-0066-c18307760.json). He offers no more, and none is added: the motorised cyclo was a working improvisation of the Saigon streets in these years, and this is a clean record of one.
